theme: 指数估值与财务指标·中证1000市盈率盘点与宽基指数对比

initial.question: 中证1000指数最新的市盈率是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT PE FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE ISVALID=1 AND INNER_CODE=106006433 AND TRD_DATE=(SELECT MAX(TRD_DATE) FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE ISVALID=1 AND INNER_CODE=106006433)

feedbacks.question: 那它同一个交易日的市净率呢？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT PB FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE ISVALID=1 AND INNER_CODE=106006433 ORDER BY TRD_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 我在做宽基之间的估值比较，把中证红利指数和上证180指数同一交易日的市盈率也拉出来，这三个指数里谁的估值最便宜？
feedbacks.gold_display: 中证红利指数8.04倍最低，上证180为10.87倍，中证1000为43.09倍
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT INDX_CNAME, PE FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE ISVALID=1 AND INNER_CODE IN (106006433,106001369,106000016) AND TRD_DATE=(SELECT MAX(TRD_DATE) FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE ISVALID=1 AND INNER_CODE=106006433) ORDER BY PE

feedbacks.question: 往回看，2025年末的时候它的市盈率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT PE FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE ISVALID=1 AND INNER_CODE=106006433 AND TRD_DATE='2025-12-31'

feedbacks.question: 换个话题，深证100指数2026年半年报的净资产收益率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT f.ROE FROM ANA_INDX_FIN_IDX f JOIN GET_INDX_GEN_INFO g ON f.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE WHERE g.ISVALID=1 AND f.ISVALID=1 AND g.INDX_CNAME='深证100指数' AND f.ENDDATE='2026-06-30'

feedbacks.question: 和中证1000同期相比，两者的净资产收益率谁更高？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT g.INDX_CNAME, f.ROE FROM ANA_INDX_FIN_IDX f JOIN GET_INDX_GEN_INFO g ON f.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE WHERE g.ISVALID=1 AND f.ISVALID=1 AND g.INDX_CNAME IN ('深证100指数','中证1000指数') AND f.ENDDATE='2026-06-30' ORDER BY f.ROE DESC
